newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Midcontinent gasoline tracks NYMEX lower.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Midcontinent gasoline tracks NYMEX lower.

text.p: U.S. Midcontinent unleaded gasoline basis eased in Chicago and Group Three on Monday, tracking NYMEX front-month unleaded lower, traders said on Monday.
Diesel fuel prices also eased modestly on weakening differentials and lower front-month heating oil futures, traders said.
Traders said stocks remain plentiful and the market will be watching closely the weekly stocks estimates from the American Petroleum Institute inventory survey.
As trade opened for the week, the Williams pipeline system had a 36-day supply of low sulphur diesel and 21-day supply of gasoline on hand, traders said.
Chicago prompt unleaded was talked 0.75/1.0 cent over the print, with later deliveries 1.0/0.75 cent under and premium steady at 2.75 cents higher, traders said.
Group Three prompt unleaded was talked 1.0/1.25 cent over the print, with later deliveries 1.0/0.75 cent under and premium 2.25 cents higher.
Group Three low sulphur diesel eased to 3.50/3.75 cents over the print for prompt deliveries, while Chicago low sulphur was 1.50/1.75 cents over the print for prompt and later deliveries.
